categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Demo: HTTPS with a single canonical host

findings.title: Demo: two redirect hops on the www host
findings.description: Fictional example. http://www.example.com goes through two redirects before the final page.
findings.recommendation: Send every variant to the final HTTPS URL in one hop.

findings.title: Demo: 404 page returns status 200
findings.description: Fictional example. A made-up URL answers 200 with the not-found template.
findings.recommendation: Return a real 404 status for unknown URLs.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Demo: every page has one H1

findings.title: Demo: 6 titles longer than 60 characters
findings.description: Fictional example. Long titles are cut off in results.
findings.recommendation: Shorten them and lead with the main phrase.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Demo: named author with a bio page

findings.title: Demo: thin category pages
findings.description: Fictional example. Four category pages have under 120 words of their own text.
findings.recommendation: Add an introduction that answers what the category is and who it is for.

findings.title: Demo: no dates on guides
findings.description: Fictional example. Guides show no published or updated date.
findings.recommendation: Show both dates and keep them in the schema.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Demo: Organization and WebSite schema present

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Demo: CLS is 0 on the home page

findings.title: Demo: hero image is 1.8 MB
findings.description: Fictional example. The largest element on mobile takes 4.9 s to paint.
findings.recommendation: Serve a resized WebP hero and preload it.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Demo: every image has width and height

findings.title: Demo: 14 images with empty alt text
findings.recommendation: Describe what each content image shows.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Demo: AI crawlers are allowed in robots.txt

findings.title: Demo: answers are buried below long intros
findings.description: Fictional example. The direct answer sits 400 words into most guides.
findings.recommendation: Put a 40 to 60 word answer under each question heading.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Demo: hero image is 1.8 MB: Serve a resized WebP hero and preload it.

items: Demo: two redirect hops on the www host: Send every variant to the final HTTPS URL in one hop.

items: Demo: 6 titles longer than 60 characters: Shorten them and lead with the main phrase.
